what: Waterfall preservation is specified as prompt prose, but file-replacement validation still accepts any nonempty candidate whose last nonblank line is numeric diff_lines, and the emit gate only checks EMIT_PLAN_STATUS.
scenario_or_breakage: The first tier-4 file-replacement candidate can drop diff_added, diff_deleted, and mechanical_churn, pass validate_file_replacement and run_emit_plan_gate, and become the winner; later size checks see only legacy diff_lines, so the mechanical/deletion exemption is silently lost.
suggested_fix: Add a small mechanical preservation check in revise-plan-with-waterfall.sh for file-replacement candidates: read the original final metadata block, and when original optional trailer keys are present require the replacement candidate to include those strict keys in its final metadata block before accepting it. Keep extract_file_replacement_candidate unchanged because it already captures lines through diff_lines; update the waterfall regression to seed a dropping candidate followed by a preserving candidate and assert the first falls through and the final plan retains the trailers.
